title: Apply power reduction formulas for $$sin^2\left(x\right)$$ and $$cos^2\left(x\right)$$.
text: Recall that $$sin^2\left(u\right)$$ $$=$$ (1 - cos(2u))/2 and $$cos^2\left(u\right)$$ $$=$$ (1 + cos(2u))/2. Rewrite the expression using these formulas first.

title: Expand the expression and identify remaining powers.
text: After substituting the reduction formulas, expand the product. You will likely have a $$cos^2\left(2x\right)$$ term and a $$cos^3\left(2x\right)$$ term that need further reduction.

title: Reduce $$cos^3\left(u\right)$$ using a known formula.
text: Recall cos(3x) $$=$$ $$4cos^3\left(x\right)$$ - 3cos(x). Alternatively, write $$cos^3\left(u\right)$$ as $$cos\left(u\right) cos^2\left(u\right)$$. Apply the reduction formula for $$cos^2\left(u\right)$$ and then use the product-to-sum formula for cos(A)cos(B), which is 1/2(cos(A-B) + cos(A+B)).
